policy: The vendored upstream serving source is retained for provenance and parity audits only. Public inference and training execute the VoiceHub-owned PyTorch architecture. Source code is MIT; published model weights are a separate Apache-2.0 work.
training_boundary: The upstream release does not publish its original training loop, optimizer, or data pipeline. VoiceHub verifies full-model gradients and implements the implied delayed-codebook next-row cross-entropy, explicitly marked as reconstructed.
